feed.title: SCCT Versus Reloaded
feed.subtitle: SCCT Versus Reloaded. A patch which makes Splinter Cell Chaos Theory Versus playable on modern hardware, adds widescreen support and fixes dozens of bugs.

entry.title: Reloaded v3.0
entry.summary: Reloaded is an unofficial patch for Splinter Cell Chaos Theory Versus and is compatible with the stock game and SCCT Enhanced. Install instructions Go to your Versus/System directory Extract the contents of the zip into this directory You will be prompted to replace SCCT_Versus.exe and should select Yes Run SCCT_Versus.exe - check the help section if you have any errors Press F12...
